method.note: A pre-boot hook sets window.__HARNESS (un-no-ops window.__TEST) and freezes the real-time loop; the sim is then stepped with __TEST.sim / __TEST.tap at exactly 1/60 s. Raw state is read from window.__PROBE.S.

tolerance.basis: every replay session matched the policy run bit-for-bit (max abs diff 0); 1e-6 only absorbs the 9-decimal rounding of snapshot values
